agent_explanation: Energy jumps from ~1790 J at step 6 to 23888 J at step 7 during collision of fast light body (m=1, vx=-47.87) with heavy near-static body (m=16.94). Post-collision, heavy body gains vx=-43.8 / speed 51.2 from near zero, while light body keeps high speed, giving ~15x momentum increase (from -47.8 to ~-787). This indicates impulse calculation bug: momentum non-conservation and massive artificial energy injection during high-speed circle-circle collision, possibly inverted mass ratio or positional correction adding velocity instead of position, amplified by 24 substeps.
